operations.name: Saw – Tube Blanks
operations.setup_note: Support and clamp the precision seamless tube without crushing it, and use the length stop to produce individual blanks with facing stock on both ends. The blanks arrive in the unhardened supplied condition.

operations.name: CNC Turn – First End
operations.setup_note: Grip the opposite end of the sawn tube blank in bored soft jaws, leaving the first end and its OD profile accessible; establish the spindle axis and first faced end as process references only. Lightly skim the accessible OD and its corner radius, then size the full through-bore and machine the first entry chamfer without regripping.

operations.name: CNC Turn – Second End
operations.setup_note: Flip the part, grip the finished OD in bored soft jaws with controlled clamping pressure, and locate the first finished face against an axial stop. Face to finished overall length, blend the remaining OD and second corner radius into the first-end profile, and machine the opposite bore chamfer without repeating the full-bore sizing cut.

operations.name: Final Shop-Floor Inspection
operations.setup_note: Present cooled, chip-free parts to the final shop-floor gauge station for SPC-sampled OD, bore and length checks, including a suitable bore-form measurement for the circularity requirement. Verify both end radii, both bore chamfers and absence of sharp edges without assigning datum status to revision markers.

clarifications.question: Which variant is required for this order: 063710, processed as shown, or 063711, processed per PS-135.6?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use 063710, processed as shown, for the provisional route.

clarifications.question: If variant 063711 is required, can you supply the governing revision of PS-135.6?
clarifications.suggested_default: Do not release variant 063711 to production until PS-135.6 has been reviewed; the current route covers only processing as shown.

clarifications.question: What commercially available precision seamless tube size and supply tolerances can be procured within the specified material-grade range?
clarifications.suggested_default: Provisionally use 95.6 mm OD by 77.0 mm ID tube, subject to supplier confirmation that its dimensional variation permits cleanup to the finished limits.

assumptions.text: The component is a single annular ring with overall finished length 15.75–16.00 mm. F03 describes the same axial envelope as F01, not an additional projecting flange or an unreported diameter step.

The provisional route is for variant 063710 processed as shown. No heat treatment, coating or functional testing is included because none is specified for that variant; PS-135.6 could change the route for 063711.

Precision seamless tube is selected under ALM-IC-001. The 95.6 mm OD and 77.0 mm ID are provisional procurement dimensions, not a verified commercial standard; the 22 mm cut length provides 6 mm beyond the maximum finished length.

The near-net tube requires only an OD cleanup skim and light bore sizing. Rough OD turning, rough boring and all drilling-from-solid steps are suppressed by the applicable corrections; the machining allowance is a nominal planning value, with actual cleanup stock determined from the supplied tube.
Each 1.6 mm outer corner radius is physically cut within its end's finish OD profile pass. No separate radius-forming sub-operation is added, as required by ALM-IC-001 and ALM-ROUTE-001.

The turning-template center drilling is unnecessary for this short, open-bore ring; grooving and threading have no corresponding features. Parting is omitted because individual blanks are sawn before the two lathe setups.

The hole-making template's spotting, pilot drilling, full drilling, peck drilling, reaming, tapping and fastener recess operations are inapplicable. The existing tube bore is finish-sized on the lathe, and entry/exit deburring is incorporated into the two specified chamfer passes.

F02 is finish-bored through once in the first setup; the second setup produces only its opposite entry chamfer. The approximately 9 mm wall permits OD finishing before bore sizing, with broad soft-jaw contact and controlled clamping to limit distortion.

The two OD radii and two bore chamfers cover all finished edges, so no separate bench deburr/clean gate is required; routine chip and coolant removal is integral to unloading. There are no prismatic features requiring milling and no explicit grind callout requiring grinding.

No drawing datums are assigned. Final inspection is one manual shop-floor gate, not CMM layout or an intermediate gate; bore circularity requires an appropriate sampled form check rather than relying on size plug gauges alone.
